verdict.rationale: UKVI publishes its own processing-times page ('Visa processing times: applications outside the UK') with dated change notes, and an online service that tells applicants when to expect a decision. This covers the core of the story: the service itself publishes current processing times. Missing for 10: evidence that times are shown specifically for the Innovator Founder route, coverage of in-UK extension/switch processing times, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the published times are current and accurate.
